label: Formulated and introduced Ataraxia (Tranquility of Mind)
description: Epicurus formulated and introduced the concept of "Ataraxia (Tranquility of Mind)", which became a seminal contribution in ethics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in ethics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Hellenistic & Roman as part of Epicurus's canonical writings.

label: Analyzed Epicurean atomism and the swerve (clinamen) in his 1841 doctoral dissertation on Democritean and Epicurean natural philosophy
description: Karl Marx was fundamentally influenced by Epicurus's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Epicurus's perspective to Karl Marx's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Hellenistic & Roman across history into the 19th Century Divergences.
